title: Trump Threatens to Double Tariffs on Mexico Unless It Stops Migrant Caravan
detail: On Nov 12 Trump posted on Truth Social that tariffs on Mexico would be doubled immediately if Mexico fails to stop a migrant caravan of roughly 1,000–2,000 people that left Tapachula, Chiapas. The post named no deadline or specific tariffs. Sheinbaum noted no caravan has reached the US border since Jan 2025. The threat came while Washington and Mexico negotiate relief on steel, aluminium and auto tariffs.

media.caption: Trump threatens to double tariffs as caravan heads north
